detail.longDescription: For performing artists (very broadly defined), here's survey from SMU DataArts of AI's potential effect(s) on performing artists, conducted by SMU DataArts and Annie Dorsen as part of Artists Make Technology. More info at the link: https:// survey.alchemer.com/s3/8855295 /3102026 Closes Sept 30. Feel free to boost, if you like. SMU DataArts have been known to do excellent work in the past, focusing on arts, community, and equity. I'm not affiliated - wish I was! # Arts # PerformingArts # research # equity
